narrative.intro: JT4 has received $376M in federal contract obligations through FY2026 to date. JT4 won 1 award this fiscal year for an average award size of $376M, and obligations are down 5.6% year over year. JT4’s obligations have varied over the past six fiscal years, with recorded totals of $322M in FY21, $325M in FY22, $391M in FY23, $385M in FY24, $398M in FY25, and $376M in FY26. JT4’s current-year total is a fiscal year to date figure, so year-over-year comparisons reflect partial current-year activity. JT4’s single large award this year drives the average award size figure. JT4’s trend shows a peak at $398M in FY25 and a drop to $376M in FY26. JT4’s award count for the current period is low, which concentrates obligations into fewer contracts and raises the average award size.
